c_index_explainer.plain_language: The C-index tells us how well the model ranks which patients are relatively higher risk versus lower risk within the same cohort. A value of 0.5 is no better than chance; higher values mean better ranking.

limitations: This is a Stage 1 prognostic demo only.
The site shows cohort-specific survival ranking, not treatment-effect estimation.
Treatment fields are observational and incomplete, and are not used to make treatment recommendations.
TCGA and METABRIC use different model inputs, so the interface adapts by cohort rather than pretending the cohorts are identical.
METABRIC subtype-dependent outputs now use the derived PAM50 field from public expression, not CLAUDIN_SUBTYPE.

controls.extra_note: TCGA predictions use age, stage, and PAM50 subtype.
METABRIC predictions use age, NPI, and the derived PAM50 subtype. Stage is not part of the current METABRIC Cox model.
